text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels rewarding, but I should avoid letting the pleasure of locking in gains alone determine when I exit.","I should assess each stock as part of the whole portfolio, weighing its prospects and risk rather than treating it as a separate account anchored to my purchase price.","My trades have often followed rising prices; before buying or selling, I should check that the decision fits a deliberate plan instead of reacting to recent moves."]}
